Players Committee card image of [[The Grand Inquisitor]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a Jedi or Padawan just lost from same site as any Inquisitor, opponent loses 1 Force. If a Jedi or Padawan just moved from here, Inquisitors present may follow that character (using landspeed). Immune to attrition < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/thegrandinquisitor.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/thegrandinquisitor.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
